The '''Ord Gustald system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gustald]].
